# Project instructions

- Keep source comments, application text, documentation, issue reports and pull requests in English.
- Complete the full review promised for a fix, including related behavior and appropriate validation. State clearly which work is complete and which remains pending.
- Prioritize startup cost, responsive playback and bounded background work. Load optional tools only when requested.
- Preserve the distinction between implemented features and planned features in `FEATURES.md` and `FeatureCatalog`.
- Keep generated builds, installers, logs, local settings and private working files out of Git.
- This repository currently publishes source only. Do not create tags, GitHub releases or uploaded binaries unless explicitly requested.
